ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80% low-intensity (black) to 20% high-intensity (white) distribution across the visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixels are concentrated in contiguous blobs at the distal tips of both lobes. The central fluke body is solid black with sparse white striations along the lower inner lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration present along the entire visible boundary. Notable deep notch (valley) located on the superior edge of the left lobe, approximately 150 pixels from the distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel vertical white striations (rake marks) detected on the inner lower quadrant of the right lobe, breaking the solid black pigmentation.

other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'constellation' of black spots within the white patch of the right distal tip, specifically one large central spot surrounded by smaller satellite points.
